# SilverStrength Club — Complete Site Guide

## Site Overview

**SilverStrength Club** is a health and fitness website for adults aged 65+. All content is written for seniors, using 18px+ body text, high contrast, simple language, and practical step-by-step instructions. The site covers mobility, strength training, resistance bands, nutrition, brain health, fall prevention, and lifestyle wellness.

- **URL**: https://silverstrength.club/
- **Audience**: Seniors 65+ and their caregivers
- **Tone**: Encouraging, practical, evidence-based
- **Font size**: 18px+ for senior readability

## Navigation Structure

The site uses a sticky dark navigation bar with these links:
- **Home** (`/`) — Landing page with hero, feature cards, and CTA
- **Mobility** (`/mobility-fall-prevention.html`) — Fall prevention and mobility exercises
- **Bands** (`/resistance-bands-seniors.html`) — Resistance band workouts for seniors
- **Strength** (`/strength-training-basics.html`) — Safe strength training
- **Nutrition** (`/nutrition-vitality.html`) — Nutrition and healthy eating
- **About** (`/about.html`) — About the site
- **Contact** (`/contact.html`) — Contact form
- **Blog** (`/blog/`) — All articles

## Content Pillars

### 1. Mobility & Fall Prevention
Keyword focus: fall prevention, mobility exercises, balance training, stability.
Key pages: mobility-fall-prevention.html (pillar), balance-exercises-seniors.html, mobility-exercises-seniors.html, mobility-drills.html, walking-programs-for-seniors.html, stretching-routines-seniors.html

### 2. Strength & Resistance Training
Keyword focus: strength training, resistance bands, senior exercise equipment.
Key pages: strength-training-basics.html (pillar), resistance-bands-seniors.html (pillar), band-routine.html

### 3. Nutrition & Vitality
Keyword focus: senior nutrition, anti-inflammatory diet, heart health, bone health.
Key pages: nutrition-vitality.html (pillar), nutrition-tips.html, anti-inflammatory-foods-seniors.html, bone-health-seniors.html, heart-healthy-eating-seniors.html, diabetes-friendly-eating-seniors.html, brain-boosting-foods-seniors.html, hydration-for-seniors.html

### 4. Mental Health & Lifestyle
Keyword focus: brain training, mindfulness, sleep, stress, social connection.
Key pages: brain-games-seniors.html, mindfulness-for-seniors.html, sleep-tips-seniors.html, stress-reduction-seniors.html, social-connection-longevity.html, hobbies-for-seniors.html, tech-guide-for-seniors.html

### 5. Low-Impact Cardio
Key pages: low-impact-cardio-seniors.html, walking-programs-for-seniors.html, chair-yoga-seniors.html

## Content Format

Every article follows this structure:
- Page header with gradient background, h1 title, and subtitle
- Featured image (2:1 aspect ratio, Unsplash photography)
- Published date and author byline
- Body content with h2 sections, h3 subsections, tip-boxes, lists
- FAQ section (where applicable)
- Related articles grid (3 cards)
- Standard navigation and footer

## SEO Metadata
All pages include:
- Open Graph tags (title, description, image, url, site_name, locale, type)
- Twitter Card tags (summary_large_image)
- Canonical URL
- JSON-LD schemas: BreadcrumbList, Article (on blog posts), FAQPage (where applicable), WebSite (on homepage), Organization (on homepage)
- Meta description (150-160 chars)
- Meta robots (index, follow, max-image-preview:large)

## Technical Notes
- HTML is self-contained — one file per page, no external CSS or JS dependencies
- CSS in inline <style> blocks
- Navigation HTML is duplicated across all pages
- Hosted on Netlify
- Deployed via Netlify ZIP API (not GitHub auto-deploy)
- Server-side rendered (no JavaScript required for content)
- Web fonts: system-ui stack (no external font loading)
- Mobile responsive with media query at 600px breakpoint
- No cookies or tracking beyond GTM/GA4

## Architecture
```
/ (root)
├── index.html              # Landing page
├── mobility-fall-prevention.html
├── resistance-bands-seniors.html
├── strength-training-basics.html
├── nutrition-vitality.html
├── about.html
├── contact.html
├── robots.txt              # AI bot allowlist + Content-Signal + sitemap
├── sitemap.xml             # All URLs with lastmod
├── feed.xml                # RSS feed
├── llms.txt                # AI short site guide (llmstxt.org)
├── llms-full.txt           # AI comprehensive site guide
├── AGENTS.md               # Coding agent guide
├── favicon.svg             # SVG favicon
├── favicon.ico             # Multi-size fallback favicon
├── apple-touch-icon.png    # 180x180 touch icon
├── icon-192x192.png        # PWA icon 192px
├── icon-512x512.png        # PWA icon 512px
├── google2eebf7195a34df4b.html  # Search Console verification
└── blog/
    ├── index.html           # Blog hub
    ├── balance-exercises-seniors.html
    ├── band-routine.html
    ├── bone-health-seniors.html
```
